page.overview:
What is Zoan?

Zoan is one of the three Devil Fruit types. This type of Devil Fruit allows a user to transform into an animal species at will, or an inter-species hybrid.

The term was first used when Dalton's Devil Fruit was used to attack Wapol.

Zoan-type Devil Fruits grant the ability to transform into a certain animal species.

Unlike Paramecia and Logia Devil Fruits, Zoans are said to have "a will of their own," even before consumption. When Kaku received his Devil Fruit, he sensed a strange, otherworldly power coming off of it, comparing it to gravity. Twelve years prior to the current storyline, when CP9 acquired the Gomu Gomu no Mi (also known as the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika), it was stolen by the Red Hair Pirates, almost as if the fruit itself conspired to not end up in the hands of the World Government.
